facts.text: Under the Vincentian Promise, the university covers all remaining tuition and mandatory fees after grants and scholarships for eligible Pell recipients.

sources.title: Vincentian Promise - University of Mount Saint Vincent
sources.quote: If you qualify, the University will cover any remaining gap in tuition and mandatory fees after your Pell Grant, New York State TAP award, and institutional scholarships. That means you can earn your four-year undergraduate degree from the Mount—completely debt free.
